description: BioNexus Scientific Rule Provenance Registry. Every rule enforced by BioNexus carries explicit, verifiable provenance: source citations with DOIs/URLs, consensus level, known exceptions, and an invariant-vs-warrant classification. This registry is data, not code: labs can fork it, extend it, or override it via BIONEXUS_RULE_REGISTRY. Edit the registry file; the Python constants in rule_provenance.py are generated from it at import time.

clinical_diagnosis_without_certification.source_citation: CLIA regulations (42 CFR Part 493); CAP accreditation checklists; EU IVDR 2017/746; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

classification.rationale: CLIA/CAP mandate: clinical diagnosis without certified validation directly impacts patient treatment decisions.

identifier_namespace_mismatch.source_citation: Data integrity invariant: joining mismatched identifier namespaces corrupts all downstream results (BN-F004)

evidence.note: Ensembl stable ID semantics differ from HGNC symbols

exceptions: Explicit mapping table provided and recorded in provenance

classification.rationale: Data integrity: joining HGNC gene symbols against Ensembl IDs produces silent one-to-many mappings indistinguishable from correct joins.

model_substitution_attempt.source_citation: BioNexus honesty policy (BNS-EF-002, BN-F010): never present heuristic output as canonical backend results

classification.rationale: Reproducibility: substituting models without detection breaks deterministic audit trails (BN-F010).

normalized_matrix_only.source_citation: Negative binomial GLM requires integer counts; Love et al. 2014 (DESeq2), Soneson & Robinson 2016 (pseudobulk)

evidence.note: Love, Huber & Anders 2014, DESeq2 negative binomial model
Ritchie et al. 2015, limma input requirements

exceptions: Exploratory marker ranking with normalized input (ceiling: PRELIMINARY)
Pseudobulk aggregation from log-normalized data with explicit disclaimer

classification.rationale: Statistical theory: negative binomial models assume integer counts; feeding normalized floats violates dispersion estimation assumptions, making p-values approximate rather than calibrated.

missing_replicates.source_citation: Biological replication is required for population-level inference; Fisher 1935, design-based inference

evidence.note: Soneson & Robinson 2018, pseudobulk requires biological replicates
Lun & Risso 2018, single-cell DE workflow pitfalls (pseudoreplication)

exceptions: Exploratory per-sample descriptive statistics (no population claim)
Screening with explicit 'no inferential claims' disclaimer

classification.rationale: Experimental design theory: with fewer replicates than the intended inferential design requires, reliable between-replicate variance estimation is not supported; population-level effects are confounded with sample-specific noise. The software can still compute, and the statistical model is still mathematically defined — what is missing is a reliable design basis for inference.

spatial_coords_present.source_citation: Spatial statistics require physical coordinates; embedding substitution invalidates Moran's I (BN-F009, BNS-II-006)

evidence.note: Palla et al. 2022, Squidpy spatial statistics framework
Li, Calder & Martin 2007, Moran's I review: weights from physical adjacency

exceptions: Embedding coordinates with explicit spatial justification and FRAGILE ceiling

classification.rationale: Spatial statistics: Moran's I assumes physical adjacency; embedding coordinates proxy for topological similarity which may correlate with but does not equal tissue-level structure.

annotation_source_recorded.source_citation: Cell-type labels require evidence support (reference atlas, marker panel); BN-F003

evidence.note: Luecken et al. 2022, single-cell best practices: annotation
Abdelaal et al. 2019, automated cell-type annotation benchmark

exceptions: Numeric cluster labels without biological identity claims
Exploratory annotation with explicit 'candidate only' disclaimer

classification.rationale: Annotation evidence limits what identity claims can be justified; numeric clusters remain valid.

multiple_testing_uncorrected.source_citation: Multiple testing correction required when testing >1 hypothesis; Benjamini & Hochberg 1995

classification.rationale: Without FDR control, individual p-values are inflated false positives; exploratory ranking tolerates this. The 0.05 alpha is a community-convention default, legitimately replaceable per study design.

missing_backend.source_citation: Backend identity conformance (BNS-EF-012..016, BN-F010): declared == observed, no silent substitution

classification.rationale: Scientific capability contract: the canonical backend defines the algorithm. Silent substitution means the result is not what was advertised — zero silent substitution policy.
